metadata.author: transcribed from live/runs by expansion agent
metadata.key_test: Re-suppression-after-porosity at floor-P1 (Mod9): a 2011-2021 democratic opening (two NLD landslides) created mobilized actors that the 2021 coup could not re-absorb, producing catastrophic fragmentation FAR worse than the pre-2011 continuous-military baseline. Second confirmation of Mod9 (after Ethiopia/Tigray, Case 11) and tests the boundary of Safeguard I (porosity-with-backstop applies at HIGH-P1; Myanmar is floor-P1 porosity-WITHOUT-backstop).
metadata.notes: PROSPECTIVE CASE - all scores are 'CONSISTENT WITH EVIDENCE THROUGH 2024-early 2025', NOT definitively proven; coded with the framework's four-code vocabulary (CONFIRMED) but every verification entry is flagged prospective/consistent. NOT falsified: the junta has NOT restored pre-2011 control - the opposite is observed. Territorial-control figures vary by source (junta ~21% per UN Security Council briefing / 2024 BBC investigation; ~one-third per independent mappers; resistance ~38-42%). Resource rents far below the 30% Safeguard E threshold -> not a rentier-locked case; resource wealth (jade, gas, rare earths) instead funds EAO conflict financing.

Myanmar.notes: fsi = ~96 (high fragility) even pre-coup (approximate). 20+ active Ethnic Armed Organizations (EAOs). Pre-coup P1 ~0.20-0.25 (floor, rising) -> below bottom-third WGI Rule of Law -> Safeguard B (Mod5) primary -> predicts catastrophic outcomes on stress. Resource rents far below 30% -> NOT rentier-locked (both versions). The 2011-2021 opening created mobilized actors (NLD, Civil Disobedience Movement, civil society, organizational capacity) that re-suppression could not re-absorb.

Myanmar.outcome_summary: Catastrophic fragmentation far worse than the pre-2011 continuous-military baseline. Junta controls ~21% of territory (UN Security Council briefing; 2024 BBC investigation); resistance + EAOs hold ~38-42% (CFR Global Conflict Tracker); ~86% of territory not under stable junta control (SAC-M, April 2024). ~18% post-coup GDP collapse; over half the population below the poverty line; FSI 100 (2024).
key_events: AAPP: at least 6,231 civilians killed by the military through end-2024 (incl. 1,144 women, 709 children), with 1,824 killed in 2024 alone - heaviest year since the coup; >7,000 by 2025
ACLED ~50,000 conflict deaths 2021-mid-2024; UN reported more than 75,000 total deaths (CFR)
over 3.5 million IDPs (UNHCR via UK House of Commons Library, March 2025); nearly 20 million in need of humanitarian assistance
KIA seized the rare-earth belt in Kachin (2024); China brokered the Lashio handback to the junta (2025)
FY2024-25 projected to contract a further ~1%

result_coding_reference.CONFIRMED: Prediction matched outcome on the specific dimension predicted
result_coding_reference.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Direction correct but magnitude, form, or timing significantly different
result_coding_reference.NOT_APPLICABLE: Prediction type not relevant to this case
result_coding_reference.coding_rule: When ambiguous between confirmed and partial, code PARTIAL. When ambiguous between partial and falsified, code PARTIAL but note ambiguity.

analysis.overall_assessment: PROSPECTIVE case: 5/5 applicable predictions CONSISTENT WITH EVIDENCE THROUGH 2024-25 (coded CONFIRMED in the four-code vocabulary, each flagged prospective). 0 falsified - the junta has NOT restored pre-2011 control. Second confirmation of re-suppression-after-porosity (Mod9), the stronger and cleaner of the two cases (longer porosity period - a full decade, two landslide elections - and more total re-suppression - a full coup - producing more catastrophic fragmentation). LIVE more defensible: Mod9 is now a TESTED core prediction and Mod6/Safeguard H supplies the centrifugal-failure classification STATIC lacks.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Re-suppression-after-porosity at floor-P1: a decade of opening created mobilized actors and organizational capacity that the coup could not re-absorb, yielding not stable authoritarian restoration but catastrophic fragmentation. Tests the BOUNDARY of Safeguard I - porosity-with-backstop applies to high-P1 cases; Myanmar is floor-P1 porosity-WITHOUT-backstop, so the re-suppression mechanism (not the backstop) governs.
analysis.baseline_impact: None; graduates Mod9 (re-suppression-after-porosity) from conjecture to a tested core prediction (now 2/2: Ethiopia/Tigray + Myanmar), cabined to floor-P1 with prior mobilization. Myanmar trajectory is a watch item into Run 6.
